Only the locale observer passes sync(true). A one-render capture matches exact theme + receipt + source key + source text hash; every member of a duplicate receipt-ID group is ineligible. Native details restore only exact current matches, regardless of order, then discard the capture. No storage, request, URL field or research-state owner was added; evidence=1 remains the existing filter.

Both GMI stylesheets retain a 44 px minimum for native summaries. The production macro renders Theme details / 主题详情 separately from Source receipt / 来源凭证, including without JavaScript. Receipt identifiers remain exact. Primary navigation labels now wrap at narrow widths; the 320 px English document fits its viewport with 44 px targets. Category shortcuts also measure at least 44 px. Their mobile sticky-header and destination offsets are paired at 61 px, keeping headers visible below the rail. Preserve native expansion and immediate reduced-motion behavior. The answer-side recovery bar wraps at 320 px and retains a 44 px action.

When an initialized primary Browse dialog lacks showModal, refreshJourney must qualify the existing full-index anchor before the opener navigates to that anchor’s href. The index’s existing return action restores the permitted nondefault theme, query, category, scope, evidence and lens. Keep URL validation and query bounds with safeReturn; arbitrary hash fields, exact opener, scroll and immutable source snapshots are not promised.

Native dialog presentation keeps the element inside main, so the current journey selector already covers the open drawer’s index link. Preserve that selector and ordinary open/search-focus lifecycle. This valid-payload capability fallback is separate from failed-data recovery. Controlled absence of one dialog method proves the branch’s contract, not historical-browser support.

A native close event can arrive after Browse has reopened. At the start of the existing close listener, return while dialog.open is true; keep its current slot and search focus. A current close still moves Browse home and returns its normal focus. Native open state is the guard—do not add a timer, generation counter or parallel dialog lifecycle. Ordinary tests await the actual close event plus home/opener-focus state; early reopen has its own explicit native-event proof.

The enhanced tree has one sequential row entry, with arrows moving among visible rows. Hidden and empty categories cannot retain a Tab stop. Its existing bilingual heading supplies the accessible name. Native theme links keep their destinations and modified-click behavior; information buttons and See all stay separately reachable. Without JavaScript, the original 371 link attributes remain.

Plain Enter/Space on a leaf delegates to the existing topic-selection owner. Preserve parent expansion, modifiers, IME and repeat handling. Before search hides active row content, focus the search input; before collapse hides a descendant, focus its nearest visible ancestor. Preserve surviving and unrelated focus. Clearing a zero-result search restores expansion and uses the first visible row as the next entry.

Index shortcuts follow their filtered groups. Hidden, detached or unowned targets cannot replace the parameter fragment; reject stale observer entries before changing current-link state. Return focus before the index hides an active row, category or shortcut. Query, lens, open state and return context keep their existing owners.

The tree’s existing no-match paragraph now sits inside one persistent polite, atomic status region. Keep focus in search, preserve its bilingual text and skip unchanged visibility writes. Clear hides the paragraph while the status owner remains mounted. A scoped CSS rule offsets the extra empty flex gap: normal spacing stays 12 px; the visible message keeps its original margins. No second announcer, timer, locale observer or query state is needed.

Primary Browse first computes which result rows and region will disappear. Before hiding an owned focus target, try reachable search, then Done inside an open native dialog or the visible opener/topic heading in the sidebar. Recheck actual focus: preserve a surviving redirect; continue the bounded fallback if focus remains in a retiring subtree. A newer synchronous filter pass cancels the stale projection. Keep surviving/unrelated focus and closed mobile Browse unchanged; skip unchanged hidden writes.

Primary Browse explains an exact public-field match in its existing secondary label slot: Company / 公司, Ticker / 证券代码, Product / 产品 or Platform / 平台. Use the current norm() and the whole query inside one field; preserve supplied connection order, then company/ticker/product/platform order. If the visible canonical topic or parent already explains the query, or no individual field does, retain the canonical parent. Never suppress against a previously rendered hint. Clear and locale updates use the existing filters owner after its pass guard. Equality-update only direct language text nodes; keep the title, anchor, badge and order. The badge still counts all published topic connections. Q05/Q06 show company and platform matches without new product controls.

Primary result ArrowUp/ArrowDown/Home/End must yield to consumed, composing/229 and Ctrl/Meta/Alt/Shift events. Require the originating anchor to belong to the current visible-row list before changing its roving stop. Keep ordinary repeat and native Enter; navigation alone preserves selection and URL.

Both existing slash handlers must yield to consumed/composing/229 keys as well as their existing modifiers and editable-focus exclusions. Shift-marked / remains eligible. Keep primary capture and legacy bubble in place; a valid primary shortcut stops the legacy action. No second shortcut or selection owner is added.

Keyboard and Browse reopen pass 8 cases / 8 fresh anonymous contexts, Chrome157.0.8103.39, zero page errors. Final PID94735: 17.01 s. Six trusted consumed-key baselines failed before repair; two original-source native close/reopen baselines separately proved the empty-dialog race.

Sixty-six result and 40 slash observations cover consumed keys, modifiers/composition/229, current visible-row ownership, plain Arrow/Home/End, trusted repeat, native Enter, Shift-marked slash, input typing and controlled contenteditable typing. Six reopen observations and two ordinary close settlements keep native event ordering explicit.

The first three-guard candidate passed 4/5 executed cases before a rapid mobile close/reopen exposed the existing delayed-close bug. The retained trace shows a real slash reopening Browse, then the old close listener removing its content while open. Native dialog.open now fences that old cleanup; no new lifecycle is added.

All 129 prior verifier definitions remain AST-exact. Reverse four guard additions to recover the parent JS. Forty-seven other render inputs, the accepted model, seven HTML pages and CSS remain exact. Six source/evidence files read back exactly. Four of six final keyboard-focus captures were inspected.

Move the status role off the hidden paragraph; retain its count/no-match spans and language owner. indexHidden still releases owned focus before a hide request, then skips unchanged visibility writes. Repeated equivalent searches and duplicate language notifications make no feedback mutations. 10 · Recover without leaving the answer
Show “This topic is outside your filters.” / “当前主题不在筛选范围内。” with Clear filters / 清除筛选 only when a valid selected topic is excluded. Invalid-topic and failed-data states keep their own explanations, without this unrelated action. Generated markup starts hidden when JavaScript is unavailable.

Do not select or rerender the answer: retain evidence-node identity, exact source fields and open receipts.

The answer-side caller returns focus to the visible topic heading; existing drawer/sidebar callers keep search focus. Before hiding a focused recovery action, focus that heading. Native modal behavior stays intact. Reuse current panel/button tokens, allow wrapping, expose the notice before changing its status text, and skip unchanged text writes. No extra timer, storage or announcement owner is needed.

Reset chooses that established heading/search destination before projecting filter visibility. Do not focus again after filters: a surviving intentional redirect must remain. Query/category/scope/evidence clear through the existing replace-URL owner; theme, lens, qualified return, evidence nodes and open receipts remain. History keeps its separate existing answer-render path.
11 · Clear the search; keep the research
The tree and full index share one localized Clear search / 清空搜索 icon button. It is hidden until JavaScript binds the existing input path. Keep the field 44 px high and the action 44 × 44 px. Replace the slash hint while the raw input is nonempty, including whitespace. Suppress the browser cancel only under the enhanced class.

Click and native Enter/Space focus the input, empty its value and dispatch the current input event once. Ordinary Escape uses that same helper; consumed, composing and keyCode229 events do nothing. The existing search, URL and expansion owners perform the reset. These tree/index actions do not clear primary Browse filters, select a different answer or redraw evidence.

Index initial/history restoration synchronizes the button from the restored value. Before hiding a focused clear action, return focus to search; preserve unrelated focus. For Escape already consumed, composing or carrying keyCode229, stop propagation and return without clearing the query, calling updateFilters or adding preventDefault. This also keeps that guarded event away from document bubble handlers while leaving the input method’s default behavior intact.

Ordinary Escape with a nonempty query keeps the existing preventDefault, stopPropagation, clear and updateFilters path. Retain the selected theme, category, scope, evidence filter, lens and answer nodes; keep focus in search. With an empty query, leave Escape to the browser so the existing native dialog cancel/close and opener-focus cleanup work. Do not add composition state, a cancel blocker, a timer or an ignore-next-close flag.

Synthetic composing/229 events prove this authored event contract, not OS-native IME behavior. Real consumed and ordinary Escape keys verify the query, history, focus and native dialog boundary separately. A one-use test cancel listener can keep the dialog open; removing that test-only prevention restores the next native dismissal.

Bind the click before adding the enhancement class; leave it hidden without JavaScript or valid topic data. Use a plain wrapper with the input’s existing bilingual name, plus scoped primary padding/native-cancel rules.

Clear only the query through updateFilters once. Retain topic, category, scope, evidence-only, lens, qualified return, other hash fields, answer/source-card nodes and open receipts. The existing filters projection owns button visibility and pre-hide focus. Capture its pass and the URL before focusing search; if a focus callback projects newer state or begins hash restoration, yield. Respect surviving focus redirects and never focus a second time. Each market displays the unchanged numerator_issuers, issuer_count_bounds, eligible_issuers_resolved and, when nonzero, eligible_securities_unresolved_issuer. Matched means linked to a company record; identity qualification is a separate condition. Unmatched listings are securities, not distinct companies. In the producer, only IDENTITY_NOT_QUALIFIED mixes those populations: subtract the unresolved-listing contribution from that one reason before showing company reasons. Do not clamp a negative value or conceal an accounting mismatch. Tests require company reasons to total matched companies minus the admitted numerator.

The accepted US input has 1 admitted company, 1,927 matched companies and 4 unmatched listings, with bounds 1,928–1,931. Its company reasons are 722 identity-unconfirmed, 1,200 vendor-only and 4 without activity: 1,926 companies. China has 0 matched companies and 1,019 unmatched listings, bounds 1–1,019, and no company-reason population. An absent breakdown never says complete coverage. Keep every configured reason label and company unit; no hidden global aggregate or fabricated complete state.

Here 1 core theme has admitted activity and 67 do not; the 303 extended themes remain separate and excluded. Themes count themes, not distinct market companies. The proposed-only note, when present, is a subset of themes without admitted activity; kind=held is not every pending proposal.

Use native details/summary for company reasons and Method & sources. Keep Enter/Space, no-JS operation and independent open states; reduced motion removes only the caret transition. The method separates admission, company matching, theme counts and public publication checks. Snapshot as of comes from model.asof; Coverage model generated comes from provenance.built_at_utc with exact datetime and UTC. Sources remain undated. Parse or schema failure leaves the source-rendered starting topic in place. Say Interactive research could not load. The starting topic is shown below. / 交互研究未能加载。下方显示起始主题。 Reveal one native Open the full index / 打开完整索引 anchor in the existing notice region. Only language changes update translated options and the failure notice. Do not add URL writes, retries, fetches, storage or a second navigation owner.

Keep Browse, Reset and Copy unavailable. Hide only the empty Related topics section whose payload container has no element children or non-whitespace text.
